text:
Alice: Heads-up — ran an inventory of audit coverage across services (API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime). Found missing event types and inconsistent schema. Need to triage into sprint backlog.
Ben: Can you paste the list? Do we have a canonical audit event schema?
Alice: doc: https://rwd.infra/SEC-3124 - summary: missing events: token_rotate, key_access, billing.invoice_viewed, console.magiclink_use, runtime.container_restart. Schema diffs: `actor_id` vs `user_id`; timestamps ms vs iso.
Carmen: For customer-facing validation we should standardize contract + publish JSON Schema + examples. Small validation harness as part of e2e.
Diego: runtime produces high volume (~10k/s) — can't log token-level events, need sampling & suppression rules. KMS: redact key ids unless customer enables export.
Maria: example event:
```
{
  "event_type": "auth.token_rotate",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T15:04:05Z",
  "actor": { "id": "user:123", "type": "service" },
  "resource": { "id": "key:abc", "type": "kms_key", "action": "access" },
  "outcome": "success",
  "metadata": { "ip": "1.2.3.4", "region": "us-west-2" }
}
```
Ben: We need versioned schema (v1,v2) and a `customer_visible` boolean to control exports.
Alice: Also add RBAC change payloads with a `diff` field showing minimal before/after.
audit-bot: created SEC-3124 and linked tasks https://rwd.infra/SEC-3124/subtasks
sre-oncall: I'll prototype sampling policy + retention for runtime; will own backlog item.
Carmen: I'll draft JSON Schema + validation harness by EOW next week. Ben please coordinate billing owner for invoice_view and payment_method_change events.
Ben: Will add to billing backlog and tag SEC-3124.
Maria: Action items: 1) owner map per service, 2) schema PR template, 3) validation CI job, 4) update customer audit export docs. Suggested due dates in doc.
Alice: Scheduling triage session Thu 10am to slot runtime+billing into next sprint unless objections.
Diego: Note on redaction: export should HMAC key ids with customer KMS; design doc needed.
Alice: Added subtask to SEC-3124.
Ben: LGTM :thumbsup:
